meta.name: auth-nodejs-cloudbase
meta.description: CloudBase Node SDK auth guide for server-side identity, user lookup, and custom login tickets. This skill should be used when Node.js code must read caller identity, inspect end users, or bridge an existing user system into CloudBase; not when configuring providers or building client login UI.

copy.tagline: 在 Node.js 后端集成 CloudBase 用户认证
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Node.js 服务端读取用户身份或对接已有用户系统到 CloudBase。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate CloudBase user authentication in Node.js backend
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to read caller identity or bridge existing user system into CloudBase from Node.js server.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude能为你提供使用CloudBase Node SDK进行服务端认证的代码：读取调用者身份、查找用户、签发自定义登录票据等。
howto.when: 当你需要在CloudBase项目的Node.js代码中处理服务端用户身份（例如云函数中读取谁在调用、查找用户信息）时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个获取云函数调用者身份的代码。
如何签发自定义登录票据给已有用户系统？
查询手机号对应的CloudBase用户信息。

howto.what_en: When loaded, Claude can generate Node.js code for CloudBase auth: read caller identity, look up users by identifiers, and issue custom login tickets.
howto.when_en: This skill triggers when working with server-side authentication in a CloudBase project using Node.js, e.g., reading caller identity in cloud functions or managing users.

say_en.text: Write code to get the caller identity in a cloud function.
How to issue a custom login ticket for my existing users?
